stories.summary: Conservative MPs Andrew Hastie and Angus Taylor held secret meetings to plot challenge against Opposition Leader Sussan Ley, but Hastie withdrew leaving Taylor as the sole rightwing challenger. stories.headline: RBA expected to raise interest rates after inflation jumps above forecasts
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia faces pressure to lift interest rates for the first time in two years after underlying inflation rose to 3.3% in December, well above the central bank's expectations. Economists predict a 0.25% rate hike at the February meeting, marking an embarrassing U-turn from last year's rate cuts.

stories.headline: Albanese navigates political challenges from Israeli president visit to Coalition collapse
